g.text: Tracing beach-material movement: reference and record
Define the fixed origin O, the direction system (+ = north along
the tape) and the 2-minute interval before starting; observe from
For each trial, find the tracer and measure its signed distance
from O along the tape; repeat the same method for every trial.
Record “not recovered” separately: an unrecovered tracer is
missing data, not a displacement of 0 m.
